headline: Congress directed its leaders to arrange a Congressional Gold Medal presentation to cyclist Greg LeMond.
what_it_does: The law tells the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for a Congressional Gold Medal to be presented to Greg LeMond. The medal honors his contributions as an athlete, activist, role model, and community leader. The summary does not describe any money, rules, or services beyond the medal itself.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 4, 2020.
